status: Public source patch prerelease and website live; v0.1.10-alpha.1 release candidate verified

components.evidence_level: Public source patch prerelease; OLED kit verified over USB and Wi-Fi
components.checks: The v0.1.10-alpha.1 hub release candidate pins gateway v0.1.0-alpha.10 and ESP32 SDK v0.2.0-alpha.12 (hub ADR 006), with Linux SDK and Home Assistant v0.1.0-alpha.5. The kit guide uses the Mac's .local name and the gateway service. On 12-13 October 2026 the owner's Mac and OLED kit passed name, two address-change and restart checks; Linux systemd, native Grok Bot MCP calls and independent reproduction are not claimed.

components.evidence_level: Simulated; Wi-Fi device listener used by one physical kit; Grok Bot local-command route observed
components.checks: 215 tests, Ruff, plain-language checks, the first-success check, package builds and twine check passed; the release workflow's fresh-download SHA256SUMS check passed. Adds the per-user service (launchd/systemd) and .local names with address following. On the owner's Mac the service started at login and followed two address changes (docs/verification/always-on-2026-10-13.md). Linux systemd is not tested on a real host. Native Grok Bot MCP calls are not verified.

55 tests passed, including the gateway integration tests against gateway v0.1.0-alpha.10; Ruff, package builds and twine check passed. The gateway extra pins gateway v0.1.0-alpha.10, so the SDK and its gateway install from PyPI. No fresh Linux container, systemd or Raspberry Pi run in this release.

components.evidence_level: Host simulated; four firmware builds compiled; OLED kit physically accepted on one board over USB and Wi-Fi
components.checks: Host CTest suites (9/9), the contract check, the gateway PTY integration and three firmware builds passed. Alpha.12 resolves a .local gateway name with ESPmDNS and verifies TLS by name; on the owner's kit it connected by name and followed two Mac address changes and a restart. Earlier USB, Wi-Fi, wrong-password and face checks stand. One kit; not independently reproduced.

Unit tests, Ruff, package builds and twine check passed; the fixture probe reports zero tool calls and resource reads. Adds the release workflow; no probe behavior change. No real Home Assistant installation or Grok Bot connection was tested.

firmware.status: build verified; hardware and Grok pending; unpublished
